name: cost-ledger
description: Tracks what Claude Code costs — session, calendar-week and calendar-month totals in the status line, a band and a /costs pane with a spend calendar, plus prompt-cache awareness: a cache warm/cold countdown, warnings before a prompt, model switch or large write re-caches the context, a per-category breakdown priced at list or your own (e.g. AWS) rates, per-project and subagent splits, budget alerts and CSV export

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: api: figures are actual spend. subscription: figures are labelled API-equivalent and rate-limit usage is shown.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show the totals as a status line entry

band.title: Band above prompt
band.description: Show the totals in a band above the prompt

rates.title: Rate overrides
rates.description: JSON of USD per million tokens by model family, overriding list prices, e.g. {"opus-5-5": {"input": 4, "output": 20, "cacheRead": 0.2, "cacheWrite5m": 5, "cacheWrite1h": 8}}

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: auto: learned from Claude Code when it reports it, else 5m

largeWriteTokens.title: Large cache write alert
largeWriteTokens.description: Toast when one request writes at least this many tokens to the prompt cache (0 turns it off)

contextNudgeTokens.title: Context size nudge
contextNudgeTokens.description: Suggest /compact once the context reaches this many tokens (0 turns it off)

dailyBudget.title: Daily budget (USD)
dailyBudget.description: Toast at 80% and 100% of this amount (0 turns it off)

weeklyBudget.title: Weekly budget (USD)
weeklyBudget.description: Toast at 80% and 100% of this amount (0 turns it off)

monthlyBudget.title: Monthly budget (USD)
monthlyBudget.description: Toast at 80% and 100% of this amount (0 turns it off)
